lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill region, forming a structured grid-like arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the circular high-luminance blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes throughout the mid-lateral flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by high-luminance top edges and sharp transitions to lower-luminance shadow gradients immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible area of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 10-14 discrete high-luminance blobs, with larger blobs situated toward the base and smaller ones toward the distal margins.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface exhibits a significantly higher density of smaller high-luminance blobs compared to the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the lateral flank.
